info.name: Altar server plan
Messdienerplan
info.description:
Altar server plan module of the Leiterrunde suite – requires the Leiterrunde app.
Duty planning for altar servers:
• Service catalog across multiple church locations • Planning periods with open/close workflow and invite tracking • Availability polls: servers submit when they can serve • Smart assignment suggestions with per-service assignments • Statistics on duties per server
Requires the Leiterrunde app for persons, roles and permissions.
info.author: Leiterrunde
